item.title: Align scope enforcement language: advisory not strict
item.intent: The orchestrator's scope injection into developer prompts must say scope is advisory with warnings, not strict — matching CLAUDE.md and actual enforcement behavior.
steps: Find where the orchestrator injects scope constraints into the developer prompt
Change language from strict enforcement to advisory: 'stay within scope; out-of-scope changes are flagged as warnings'
This is an orchestrator injection change, not an agent prompt rewrite
